passages.text: Three Chinese AI labs just ran 16 million conversations with Claude through 24,000 fak

This post argues that distillation isn’t espionage. It’s piracy. And like every piracy wave before it, it doesn’t stop — it slows down. The real story is that the incentive to extract frontier capabilities applies to everyone, not just state-backed Chinese lab
